title: Chinese Multi-provincial Cohort Study-Beijing Project
brief_summary: The Chinese Multi-provincial Cohort Study (CMCS)-Beijing project is a sub-study in CMCS participants from Beijing, which intended to investigate the progression and determinants of atherosclerosis and aging related health problems through repeat examinations. Exam 0 to Exam 3 have been conducted during 1992 to 2012. Exam 4 is scheduled in 2020.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Participants from CMCS-Beijing
* sign the informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* participanting in clinical trials
study_population: Study participants were recruited from the Chinese Multi-provincial Cohort Study-Beijing Project
